messages:
rachel: quick spike: q4_0 export of nebula-v1 vs fp16 baseline on zh-Hans->en devset shows BLEU -3.0. pattern: thousands separators become U+066C (ARABIC THOUSANDS SEPARATOR) in some outputs.
mitsu: that's an odd codepoint to appear in CJK outputs. can you paste a minimal repro + tokenizer traces?
rachel: here you go.

input: 预计2026年总营收将达到2,500,000元。
baseline (fp16): Total revenue in 2026 is expected to reach 2,500,000 yuan.
nebula-q4: Total revenue in 2026 is expected to reach 2260066C000 yuan.

rachel: you can see the thousands were split and the separator turned into U+066C in the q4 output (renders oddly in some terminals).
infra-bot: eval job #20241 completed: BLEU delta -3.0 (p < 0.01). Artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/nebula-q4/20241
mitsu: token traces please.
rachel: baseline.tokens: ["预计", "2026", "年", "总营收", "将", "达到", "2", ",500,000", "元", "。"]
nebula-q4.tokens: ["预计", "2026", "年", "总营收", "将", "达到", "2", "\u0000", "600", "\u066C000", "元", "。"]
mitsu: hmm the q4 tokenization shows weird zero bytes and U+066C inserted around digit boundaries. sounds like a packing/unpacking bug in the detok table or a wrong endianness assumption when reading mapping tables for punctuation.
ops-sam: production impact? any downstream failures?
rachel: a few analytics pipelines that aggregate revenue totals failed validation in canary; JSON number regexes didn't accept the embedded U+066C, causing ingestion to drop rows. Rolled z-route to fp16 for affected route.
ci-bot: bisect job created: https://ci.internal/ci/jobs/bisect-detok-20242 (estimate 90m)
mitsu: quick mitigation: add a post-detok sanitizer in serving that normalizes any non-ASCII grouping separators inside digit runs to ASCII comma and strips null/control bytes. low-risk and reversible. I'll PR a tiny shim.
ops-sam: also add a temporary Canary rollback to fp16 for zh->en. Doing now.
infra-bot: routing change applied: zh->en canary routed to fp16.
rachel: adding regression tests under tests/locale/zh_thousands_sep_normalize.json and filing ticket RD-7211 "q4 export detok mapping causing non-Latin thousands separators in numeric contexts". tagging eng-ml, eng-runtime, infra. https://tickets.internal/RD-7211
mitsu: long-term: add a detok-mapping byte-dump comparison in export tests (FP16 vs quant) and ensure export zero-inits mapping buffers. Also bisect quant kernel changes that touched detok.
ops-sam: agreed. once bisect gives a suspect commit range we'll decide between runtime guard and kernel fix. good catch rachel. :thumbsup:
